skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the nature of logistics and business logistics management.
Understand the role, content, and perspectives of business logistics management.
Identify and explain the characteristics and activities of logistics and business logistics management.
Classify various operations in business logistics management.
Manage customer service operations including order cycles and performance metrics.
Manage inventory creation and purchasing processes.
Manage transportation decisions and logistics operations.
Manage warehouse operations, packaging, and reverse logistics.
Organize and control logistics operations within businesses.
Demonstrate independence, personal responsibility, and teamwork.
